layouts.name: Sonoma Kart Circuit
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Full northern hairpin, middle return and southern chicane course at the operator karting center. The catalogue branch identity excludes the middle diagonal shortcut, separate northern extension and paddock/skid-pad access. Exact independent nodes retain the 1197.8 m route against the 1103 m catalogue scalar; distance, historical alignment and direction remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1197.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
